# latest end

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:latestEnd`](gmeow-latestEnd.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/latestEnd>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The latest instant by which an event must have ended — the upper bound of a fuzzy / approximate date ([xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)). Pairs with [`gmeow:earliestStart`](gmeow-earliestStart.md) and a [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](gmeow-temporalPrecision.md) value.

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the upper bound of a fuzzy or approximate date, paired with [`gmeow:earliestStart`](gmeow-earliestStart.md) and a [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](gmeow-temporalPrecision.md) value to bracket when an event could have occurred.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for a crisp instant ([`gmeow:eventTime`](gmeow-eventTime.md)) or span ([`gmeow:eventInterval`](gmeow-eventInterval.md)), and avoid stating it alone — it is the companion upper bound to [`gmeow:earliestStart`](gmeow-earliestStart.md).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:latestEnd`](gmeow-latestEnd.md) as an [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) alongside [`gmeow:earliestStart`](gmeow-earliestStart.md) and [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](gmeow-temporalPrecision.md); leave fuzzy-interval reasoning to the solver layer (P12).

### Examples

- ex:battle [`gmeow:latestEnd`](gmeow-latestEnd.md) "1859-12-31T23:59:59Z"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
